name: Element
install: npm install --prefix ../pnpm --no-save --no-audit --no-fund pnpm@12.11.2 && PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" PNPM_CONFIG_PM_ON_FAIL=ignore pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

build.command: PATH="$(cd ../pnpm/node_modules/.bin && pwd):$PATH" NX_DAEMON=false NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_TUI=false pnpm --dir apps/web build
